Odsherred is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, with a specific focus on Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant treatment [^src1]. Odsherred's data regarding stroke (apopleksi) events among atrial fibrillation patients is incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations for this indicator [^src1]. Because the available evidence consists solely of its statistical inclusion in a single data table, no further details regarding the municipality's specific healthcare initiatives, relationships, or historical timeline are documented in the corpus.
